site.name: Aetna Mine
overview: Aetna Mine is a documented historic gold-silver mine in Clear Creek County, preserved as a named mine feature on Georgetown-area topographic mapping.
moreHistory: USGS-derived mapping places Aetna Mine near 39.709154, -105.692226 at about 8,596 feet elevation. The mapped mine locality identifies the historic property; no claim is made that a surviving shaft, portal, or other opening has been field-verified or is accessible today.

sourceReferences.title: USGS-derived Aetna Mine topographic feature record
